note: Approved, deployed surfaces only. The full list lives in registry-master.json.

surfaces.name: SPLIT
surfaces.blurb: Figure-ground reversal type generator. Two tones only, always exact opposites — grid and pinwheel modes, up to 48 blades per glyph. The reversal is conserved: nothing lost or added in the exchange.

surfaces.name: Sortition Congress
surfaces.blurb: A legislature chosen by lot instead of election. A working model of government by random sample.

surfaces.name: CIRCLEFORNIA
surfaces.blurb: Measures any point on Earth against California. A california equivalent finder — the state as a unit of comparison.

surfaces.name: SOMESET GENERATOR
surfaces.blurb: A sunset that never settles. Geometry fixed, colour continuous — mostly almost-plausible, sometimes not. Press set to freeze one mid-transition, rise to let it go.

surfaces.name: BZ
surfaces.blurb: A chemical clock rendered as a field: bromate oxidation held far enough from equilibrium that it oscillates instead of settling. Three coupled species on a torus, each cell reacting against the mean of its neighbours — reaction against diffusion. The spiral cores are phase singularities, points where the oscillation has no defined phase and the medium must wind around them.
